boundary: protocol-v1-shaped unregistered task-local adapter; mirrors adapters/controls request and result fields
invariants: No public ABI, header, descriptor, registry default, installed behaviour, CONTRACTS.md or CMakeLists.txt change is included.
All controls are explicit, numeric, finite and range checked; absent controls are rejected rather than defaulted.
Each process call consumes exactly 160 samples and emits exactly 160 float32 samples with zero content delay.
Session state is keyed by session_id and canonical control digest; stale epochs reject before state changes.
Nonfinite input is observed and reported, never serialized as a result sample and never treated as a quality claim.
Headroom is measured against the configured hard ceiling; clipped and nonfinite-mapped samples are counted explicitly.
No missing result qualifies a candidate; unreached recovery and absent real qualification remain incomplete.
Fixed v0 format is unchanged: 16 kHz mono f32, 160 samples per frame.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; proposal-only reference and deterministic synthetic fixture
